title: setup hook --harness opencode writes the generated OpenCode 2 plugin .opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. OpenCode 2 loads `.opencode/plugins/*.js` and runs only the v2 form, so jitso writes a generated file that starts with its marker line and exports `{ id: "jitso-guard", setup }`; setup registers `execute.before`, runs `jitso hook guard` synchronously, in the session's project folder (`ctx.location.directory`: `opencode run` works through a background service whose own folder is not the project), with a Claude-shaped PreToolUse input (shell and bash become `Bash`, and an orca MCP tool, named `<server>_<tool>` by OpenCode, becomes `mcp__<server>__<tool>`) and throws the deny reason. The preview shows it as one line, a second run is nothing to do.

stdout: note: commit .opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js so linked worktrees and other clones get the guard
stderr: jitso: warning: jitso is not on PATH, so the hook cannot start until it is (the guard then lets every call through)

regex: ^// generated by jitso \S+: jitso setup hook; do not edit

stdout.equals: jitso setup hook: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js)
